review.tagline: Agent workspace with builder, groups, scheduling and 10,000+ MCP skills
review.summary: LobeHub is a self-hostable agent workspace that runs on Vercel, Zeabur, Sealos, Alibaba Cloud or Docker Compose. It centres on an Agent Builder, Agent Groups that work a task in parallel, Pages for co-writing, scheduled runs, projects and shared workspaces, plus structured editable memory and an IM gateway, with 10,000+ tools and MCP-compatible plugins. An OpenAI API key is required to start.
review.audience: Teams wanting a multi-agent workspace with an app-like UI
strengths: One-click deploy buttons for Vercel, Zeabur, Sealos, RepoCloud and Alibaba Cloud
10,000+ tools and MCP-compatible plugins for agents
Agent Groups, scheduled runs, projects and team workspaces
Memory is structured and editable rather than a hidden store
weaknesses: OPENAI_API_KEY is a required environment variable
Docker setup runs a curl-piped script from lobe.li before docker compose up
README recommends a third-party API reseller through an affiliate link
README states no ports, databases or hardware requirements
